place_of_origin: 南阳郡涅阳县（今河南邓州）
intellectual_tradition: 中医临床医学/经方学派/辨证论治
representative_works: 《伤寒杂病论》（后析为《伤寒论》与《金匮要略》）
historical_significance: 张仲景（约150—约219），名机，南阳涅阳人，东汉末医学家，后被尊为'医圣'。建安纪年疫病流行，宗族二百余口十年间死者三分之二，遂'勤求古训，博采众方'，撰《伤寒杂病论》十六卷。以六经辨证建模外感热病的传变结构，以方证对应实现'辨—治—验—再辨'的临床闭环，以条文体留下可复现的实验规程。华佗与仲景并称，但华佗医术随人亡而绝，仲景的方法随文本而传——《伤寒论》成为此后一千八百年中医临床的操作系统，六经辨证、方证对应、治未病等概念至今仍是中医的元语言。其'辨证论治'使医学从经验集合升级为可检验的系统：病是变量，证是函数，方是算法。
core_thoughts: 六经辨证系统法（系统建模/疾病演进动态分类）
八纲归因定位法（诊断归因/症状降维）
方证对应闭环法（验证闭环/疗法与诊断的绑定）
同病异治对称法（对称性思维/治疗逻辑对偶）
治未病优先法（预防医学/时机学）
剂量—配伍权衡法（参数调优/组分配比）
四诊合参信息融合法（多源信息融合/观察规范）
误治坏病逆推法（错误利用/逆向推理）
经方标准模块法（模块化复用/标准化）
文本留验传世法（知识工程/可复现性设计）
famous_quote: 观其脉证，知犯何逆，随证治之。
influence: 《伤寒杂病论》经王叔和整理、宋代校正医书局刊定后成为中医临床的元典：六经辨证框架统治外感病学一千八百年，方证对应的经方体系至今仍是中医临床的主流范式；'治未病''辨证论治'进入了当代中医高等教育与《中医药法》的话语体系。日本的汉方医学直接以《伤寒论》经方为国家医保目录内的标准化处方，'方证对应'在东亚完成了从古籍到监管科学的迁移。现代医学教育的循证、临床路径与复盘文化，都能在坏病章与方后注中找到方法论原型。仲景证明了：医学要对抗的不仅是疾病，还有'各承家技，终始顺旧'的知识生态——把规程写成文本，是把个体经验转化为可累积科学的第一步。

cross_references.description_zh: 与伊本·西那的医学系统论镜像：伊本·西那以《医典》把医学组织为'原理-药物-疾病-疗法'的四分百科，以七则药物检验法逼近对照实验；张仲景以六经辨证把临床组织为状态机、以方证对应实现诊断-治疗闭环。二人相隔约八个世纪、互不知晓，却独立收敛于同一答案：医学要成为科学，先要成为系统。
cross_references.description_en: A mirror of medical systematization: Ibn Sina organized medicine as a fourfold encyclopedia in the Canon with seven drug-testing rules approximating controlled trials; Zhang Zhongjing organized the clinic as a state machine via the six meritians and closed the diagnosis-treatment loop through formula-pattern correspondence. Eight centuries apart and mutually unknowing, they converged independently on the same answer: for medicine to become a science it must first become a system.

cross_references.description_zh: 与司马迁的'书写者'对偶：司马迁以列传体为人物立传，仲景以条文体为疾病立传——两种文体的共同内核是'以文本对抗遗忘'。差异在立场：史家面向读者叙事，医家面向同行发布可复现规程；司马迁写别人，仲景写自己的实验记录。二者合观，构成中国'知识存续'的文史两翼。
cross_references.description_en: A duality of the text-preservation stance: Sima Qian wrote biographies of people in narrative form; Zhang Zhongjing wrote 'biographies' of diseases in clause form—the shared core is 'fighting oblivion with text.' The stances differ: the historian narrates for readers; the physician publishes reproducible protocols for peers; one wrote others, the other wrote his own experiment log. Together they form the literary and scientific wings of knowledge survival in China.

cross_references.description_zh: 与张仪的棋盘对偶：张仪在多国棋盘上建模对手的联盟结构并逐国拆解，仲景在人体棋盘上建模疾病的传变结构并逐经拦截——同为'状态机思维'，一个用于外交博弈，一个用于临床演进。张仪的杠杆是信息不对称，仲景的杠杆是疾病规律的可预测性；一个操纵别人的判断，一个预测自然的进程。
cross_references.description_en: A board-game duality with Zhang Yi: on the multi-state chessboard Zhang Yi modeled opponents' coalition structures and dismantled them state by state; on the human-body board Zhang Zhongjing modeled the disease's transmission structure and intercepted it meridian by meridian—both state-machine thinking, one for diplomacy, one for clinical evolution. Zhang Yi's lever was information asymmetry; Zhang Zhongjing's was the predictability of disease law—one manipulates judgments, the other forecasts natural processes.

C-ZZJ-001.description_zh: 仲景以'脉浮，头项强痛而恶寒'七字定义太阳病状态节点——不描述个案，而定义状态机的入口判据；此后千年外感病学都在这张地图上运行。

C-ZZJ-002.description_zh: 高热病人反而想穿衣服——望诊与问诊的矛盾读数没有丢弃，而是标记为'反'字线索，导出'热在皮肤，寒在骨髓'的真寒假热判别：矛盾即诊断要害。

C-ZZJ-003.title_zh: 桂枝汤方后注的实验规程
C-ZZJ-003.description_zh: '啜热稀粥一升余，温覆令一时许，一服汗出病差，停后服'——给药、保温、观察、停药全部协议化：史上最早的给药后观察与反馈停药规程。

C-ZZJ-004.title_zh: 腰以上肿发汗、腰以下肿利水
C-ZZJ-004.description_zh: 同一水肿病，按病位坐标分裂为两条相反治法——病名相同而治法相反对称成立，因为治疗的对象是证候坐标而非疾病标签。

C-ZZJ-005.title_zh: 见肝之病，知肝传脾，当先实脾
C-ZZJ-005.description_zh: 治疗目标不是当前病灶而是下一状态：预判肝病的下游传变并提前加固脾脏——以演进模型为前提的预防性干预，史上最早的'下游加固'条文。

C-ZZJ-006.title_zh: 桂枝加一倍，方名换一场
C-ZZJ-006.description_zh: 桂枝汤中桂枝由三两增至五两即名桂枝加桂汤、主治奔豚——组方不变而主治跳变：方剂是参数化系统，调参优先于换方。

C-ZZJ-007.title_zh: 痛斥'省疾问病，务在口给'
C-ZZJ-007.description_zh: 《自序》点名单通道诊断的系统性风险：只凭问诊三言两语便处方——四诊合参是多源信息融合的最早规范，融合不足即事故之源。

C-ZZJ-008.title_zh: 坏病章：'观其脉证，知犯何逆'
C-ZZJ-008.description_zh: 误治后证候紊乱，仲景不给方、只给方法——从坏象逆推'病怎么走、医怎么错'双线索：把每一次误治都当作信息量最大的受控实验。

C-ZZJ-009.title_zh: 桂枝汤家族的接口稳定
C-ZZJ-009.description_zh: 桂枝加桂、加芍、加葛根、小建中……十余变体共享同一基方接口与文档化加减法——经方是医学史上最早的经过规模验证的函数库，边界条款'阳盛则毙'随接口一并发布。

C-ZZJ-010.title_zh: '虽未能尽愈诸病'的边界声明
C-ZZJ-010.description_zh: 《自序》在传世文本中显式写下系统的失效域与对同行生态的批判——条文体存规程、序言存立场：真正的传承是留下别人能重新得出结论的规程。

C-ZZJ-001E.description_en: Rather than describing a case, Zhang Zhongjing defined the entry criteria of a state machine—'floating pulse, stiff painful head and nape, aversion to cold'; a thousand years of external-disease medicine ran on this map.

C-ZZJ-002E.description_en: A feverish patient craving more clothing—the conflicting readings of inspection and inquiry are not discarded but flagged as a 'yet'-clause leading to the true-cold/false-heat discrimination: contradiction is the diagnostic crux.

C-ZZJ-003E.title_en: The Post-Formula Protocol of Guizhi Tang
C-ZZJ-003E.description_en: 'Sip hot thin gruel, cover warmly for an hour; when sweating resolves the illness after one dose, stop'—administration, warming, observation, and stopping fully protocolized: history's earliest post-administration observation and feedback-stopping protocol.

C-ZZJ-004E.title_en: Edema Above the Waist Sweated, Below the Waist Drained
C-ZZJ-004E.description_en: One edema, split by the location coordinate into two opposite treatments—the same disease with symmetrically opposed therapies works because treatment targets the pattern coordinate, not the disease label.

C-ZZJ-005E.title_en: See the Liver Sick, Fortify the Spleen First
C-ZZJ-005E.description_en: The target is not the current lesion but the next state: foreseeing the liver disease's downstream transmission and reinforcing the spleen in advance—preventive intervention predicated on a progression model, the earliest explicit 'downstream reinforcement' clause.

C-ZZJ-006E.title_en: One More Liang of Cinnamon, A New Formula
C-ZZJ-006E.description_en: Raising Cinnamon from three to five liang renames Guizhi Tang into Guizhi Jia Gui Tang for running-piglet qi—composition unchanged while the indication jumps: a formula is a parameterized system; tune before you switch.

C-ZZJ-007E.description_en: The preface names the systemic risk of single-channel diagnosis—prescribing after a few words of questioning alone; the four-examination fusion is the earliest protocol for multi-source information fusion, its absence a source of error.

C-ZZJ-008E.description_en: When mistreatment scrambles the presentation, Zhongjing gives no formula—only a method: from the wreckage back-infer both 'how the disease moved' and 'how the physician erred,' treating every error as the most information-dense controlled experiment.

C-ZZJ-009E.title_en: The Stable Interface of the Guizhi Family
C-ZZJ-009E.description_en: A dozen variants share one base-formula interface with documented modification clauses—the canonical formulas are medicine's earliest scale-verified function library, with the boundary clause 'death in yang excess' shipped alongside.

C-ZZJ-010E.description_en: The preface writes the system's failure domain and its critique of the guild ecology into the surviving text—the body stores protocols, the preface stores stance: true legacy is leaving others the protocol to re-derive the conclusions.

meta.source: 《伤寒论》《金匮要略》《伤寒杂病论·自序》
meta.methodology: 历史文献分析法、理论解析法、案例验证法、对偶对标法（与M-SQ深度范式逐条对齐）
meta.validation: 与《伤寒论》《金匮要略》原文及伤寒学史研究文献交叉验证；模式结构与H-ZY-001深度档案同构
